Harvested Remain.summary: A marker on a corpse, generated when a character drops to 0 HP within your Attunement Range. You begin each scene with 1 Harvested Remain. The placer senses each active Remain through any obstruction.

Charge.summary: A placed marker on an object, character, or 5 ft square with a declared trigger. On detonation, deals area energy damage and leaves dangerous terrain.
spent_by: Detonate (Free Action, on the placer's turn)

Ordained Ground.summary: A designated 5 ft square. An ally that begins its turn on the square gains +1 to all defenses until the start of its next turn and may use the Aid action at up to 30 ft from the square.

Snare.summary: A single-use trap on a 5 ft square. First enemy to enter takes [Tier][Die] + Awareness keen damage and is Restrained until the start of the placer's next turn.

Edict.summary: A declared prohibited action placed on a character. The first time the bound character takes the prohibited action, it takes [Tier][Die] + Intellect spirit damage and is Disoriented until the start of the placer's next turn; the Edict is then consumed.

Covenant.summary: A sworn pact with one willing ally. While the Covenant holds and both are within Attunement Range of each other, both gain +1 to all defenses and may use the Aid action targeting each other at any range within Attunement Range. Ends if either party deliberately attacks the other.

Combat Construct.summary: A singular persistent companion entity. Has HP equal to [Tier][Die] + tier x 2, deflect 1, Speed 25 ft, defenses equal to its creator minus 2, and one melee attack per turn. Acts on the creator's initiative after their turn. If destroyed, can be reforged. Upgraded by most of the Civilization tree.

Foundation.summary: A designated 10 ft square. Allies that begin their turn in a Foundation gain +1 to all defenses until the start of their next turn.
